page.overview:
Who is Mindy?

Mindy is a major character in Together Forever, the third story in Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Mindy is freckled, redheaded, and small for her age. She has puffy and pudgy round cheeks, straight hair that hangs just below her narrow shoulder blades, a dimpled chin, pudgy arms, pale skin, and reddish-blonde eyebrows. Mindy prefers wearing gingham, polka dots, animal prints, and little floral patterns. She also has sparkling purple shoes with rainbow-colored shoelaces. For most of the story, Mindy wears a full-skirted short dress. The next day, she wears her favorite corduroy jumper with a red-and-yellow frilly blouse.
